description: A brown patterned court gown has a low square neckline, fitted bodice with gold woven front bands, elbow-length sleeves and a floor-length skirt with a below-knee opening. A wide gold-brown sash has a round jeweled clasp and hanging ornaments. A golden embroidered wrap rests around the forearms. Gold earrings, a broad bracelet, rings and a gold patterned shoe finish the outfit.
